blocks.text:
After breakfast, you begin exploring the Festival of the Virgin of Candelaria.

The celebrations take place in early February and last around 2 weeks. The main costumed parade is held on 2 February.

Priests carry the statue of the Virgin of Candelaria through the city, accompanied by a church choir and musicians.

One of the festival’s most striking elements is the devil dance. According to legend, miners were held captive by demons but were rescued by the Virgin Mary of Candelaria, whom they regarded as their patron saint.

Since then, on 2 February, dancers have worn colourful costumes and masks with twisted horns to perform the traditional dance in honour of the patron saint of miners and farmers.

The festival’s final ritual involves visiting the cemetery and honouring the dead.

Overnight at the Sol Plaza 3* hotel or a hotel of the same category.
